Operating System

Fall 2026 · Undergraduate

An exploration of the ideas that make modern computing possible: processes, memory, files, concurrency, and the relationship between hardware and software.

Topics covered

  • Processes and threads
  • CPU scheduling and synchronization
  • Virtual memory and file systems
  • Systems calls and operating system structure
  • Protection, isolation, and performance
